req_desc: A public catalogue of the studio's directed films is the product's primary surface ...
A Visitor role browses the catalogue, filters, opens a case study, reads the feed, plays a podcast preview, searches ...
Sign-in exchanges an email plus a password for a bearer token carrying an expiry ...
The route `/work` serves the catalogue with its facet control, its counts ...
The default ground on every route is a near-white neutral sheet ...
Every icon is inline geometry; no icon font, no icon file ships ...
The datastore is `PostgreSQL`, reached at `DATABASE_URL` from the environment ...
Every amount is an integer in minor units carrying a lowercase currency code ...
One studio exists: no second tenant, no organisation switcher ...
